card.name: Punctuation after year in citations
card.fires_on: The period, comma or closing parenthesis right after an author name or publication year in a reference list entry, just before the work's title.

modes.label: After year
modes.description: The period or closing parenthesis directly after a year following the author names.

modes.label: After author names
modes.description: A comma or period after the authors, before the title.
modes.example: - Herbert S. Parmet and Marie B. Hecht<<,>> Aaron Burr (1967)

card.writes: It mostly suppresses stamp-like words and promotes a few odd tokens, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the punctuation in a bibliography entry just before the title of the cited work begins.
